Adapter descriptions and unknown QueryInterface behavior live here.
Factory/adapter probing covers interfaces through IDXGIFactory7 and IDXGIAdapter3, stable enumeration, memory-budget reporting/event lifetime, and safe content-protection rejection.

required_behavior: GetDesc and GetDesc1 return stable fields
QueryInterface failures log the exact IID and return E_NOINTERFACE
IDXGIAdapter3 video-memory budget event registration owns a duplicate event handle until unregister
unsupported hardware-content-protection teardown notifications return DXGI_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED without asserting
QueryInterface succeeds for IDXGIFactory through IDXGIFactory7
RegisterAdaptersChangedEvent duplicates and owns the caller event until successful unregister
adapter-change events remain unsignaled while the static Metal device list is unchanged and unknown cookies are rejected
D3D12 device QueryInterface succeeds for IDXGIDevice through IDXGIDevice3
EnqueueSetEvent remains unsignaled while any command queue is blocked on earlier work
EnqueueSetEvent signals only after completion markers on every live D3D12 queue and retains its own event handle
EnqueueSetEvent rejects a null handle with E_INVALIDARG
GetBuffer returns the renderable backbuffer for the current frame
Present uses the intended backbuffer/drawable lifecycle
Present count progresses after successful presents
